notes.title: Patch 0.4:
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and thank you for giving my game a shot! 

Here's a list of small changes I've made to the game to make the game age better!
- Made level three a bit easier to find the code for the door.
- Added more colliders so you can't clip through walls.
- Made finding the code for the easter egg easier.

That's all the changes I've made!
Thank you all for giving my game a try and making me a better developer!
